narrative: DSP Satbir Singh was suspended after allegations of a brutal lathi charge on sanitation workers, including women, in Barnala city. The suspension was ordered under Rule 4(1)(a) of the Punjab Civil Services (Punishment and Appeal) Rules, 1970, following a Patiala Range DIG-led inquiry. His headquarters during suspension was set at the 4th Commando Battalion, SAS Nagar. Sanitation workers and political leaders demanded strict action, including an FIR under the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act. Protests spread across Punjab following the incident.
status_detail: DSP Satbir Singh suspended under Punjab Police rules. Prima facie findings from video-based report. Final fact-finding report pending.
